segments: Today we're going to talk about something that really happened to you.
I'll go first and then it'll be your turn.
On Friday I finished a big puzzle.
It took ages, so I was really proud when it was done.
I was excited to show my friend.
I rode it round the garden.
You rode it round the garden lots of times.
How did you feel when you got the bike?
You must have been so happy.
We had cake because it was my birthday.
Chocolate cake, because it was your birthday.
You blew out the candles and went to bed.
Let me say your story back to you.
You had your birthday at home in the garden.
You opened your presents first and got a blue bike, and you rode it round the garden lots of times.
You had chocolate cake because it was your birthday, and at the end you blew out the candles and went to bed.
Thanks for telling me your story.
You did a really great job.

labelled_transcript: Therapist. Hi there. Today we're going to talk about something that really happened to you. I'll go first and then it'll be your turn. On Friday I finished a big puzzle. It took ages, so I was really proud when it was done. I was excited to show my friend. Okay, now it's your turn. Child. My birthday. It was my birthday. Therapist. Your birthday! Where did you have it? Child. At home. In the garden. Therapist. At home in the garden. What happened? Child. I opened my presents first. I got a bike. Therapist. You got a bike! What happened next? Child. I rode it round the garden. Lots of times. Therapist. You rode it round the garden lots of times. Who came to your birthday? Child. Um. I don't know. Therapist. That's okay. How did you feel when you got the bike? Child. I don't know. It's blue. Therapist. It's blue. You must have been so happy. Then what? Child. We had cake because it was my birthday. Therapist. Chocolate cake. Chocolate cake, because it was your birthday. How did it end? Child. I blew out the candles. Then I went to bed. Therapist. You blew out the candles and went to bed. Let me say your story back to you. You had your birthday at home in the garden. You opened your presents first and got a blue bike, and you rode it round the garden lots of times. You had chocolate cake because it was your birthday, and at the end you blew out the candles and went to bed. Did I get that right? Child. Yeah. Therapist. Thanks for telling me your story. You did a really great job.
